content.what_it_is: `SourceTerms` assembles momentum source arrays. It builds regular, spectral, time-series or 2-D wavemaker mass forcing; combines breaking and sponge viscosity; and, for Cartesian grids, adds bed-slope, friction, dispersive, wavemaker, current-balance, breakwater, wind and mixing/viscous contributions (L52-L399). The non-Cartesian branch supplies slope/friction/dispersion/Coriolis terms with ZALPHA variants (L400-L468), followed by optional vessel and pressure additions.
entities: SourceTerms at L52 with GLOBAL plus conditional VESSEL_MODULE/METEO_MODULE imports
local default-real nu_vis(Mloc,Nloc), initialized logical PQ_scheme, SP xmk/ymk/DXg/DYg/WK_Source, and integers kd/kf around L62-L66
GLOBAL wave component arrays, source arrays, velocity/transport/depth/dispersion fields, viscosity fields, meteorological fields and vessel pressure fields consumed by the routine
unresolved: WaveMaker_Mass is assigned only inside the spatial maker window and only when one recognized WAVEMAKER prefix matches. The array is not cleared at routine entry, so cells outside the window and cells after a mode change can retain a previous time step's mass forcing; SourceX/SourceY consume it unconditionally in the Cartesian loop.

All non-Cartesian wavemaker coordinates use fixed DX(1,1)/DY(1,1), even though later source derivatives use DX(I,J)/DY(I,J). A spatially varying curvilinear grid therefore receives a maker window and phase based on the first cell rather than physical coordinates.

The large CARTESIAN branch applies WaveMaker_Mass, friction sponge, current-balance drag, breakwater drag, METEO wind, MIXING and breaking/sponge viscosity. The non-Cartesian branch begins at L400 and reaches the loop end without corresponding terms. Feature flags can therefore silently lose their configured forcing outside Cartesian builds.

Regular and spectral ramp factors divide by Time_ramp and period/frequency quantities without zero-domain checks. The time-component mode additionally divides by each WAVE_COMP(kf,1). Invalid input causes singular forcing before any guard.
nu_vis is declared default REAL while its sources and all arithmetic use SP. If SP differs from default real, breaking/sponge viscosity is narrowed before entering momentum sources.

PQ_scheme is initialized false and never changed, making the P/Q viscosity branch unreachable. The comment attributes this to missing processor exchange, so this is a hard-coded distributed-memory workaround rather than a selectable scheme.
Local integer kd is declared but never used. Its presence alongside kf suggests removed directional/component logic and should be reconciled with the active wave loops.

CARTESIAN centered dispersive derivatives read I±1/J±1 and the disabled PQ path reads I+2/J+2 while the computation loop is Ibeg:Iend/Jbeg:Jend. Safety depends on ghost widths and exchanged P/Q/U4/V4 contracts not enforced in this routine.
